name: Lifesigns
source:
Everything here is so different. A bit scary, but... we’ll get used to it, right?

Your normal life burns and falls apart around you. You toss your favorite mug and a book into your bag and embark on a quest, a search for a place where you can be found once more. The tower of concrete and glass claws at the skies, city hums, neon light shines bright even at night. Light is everywhere, there is plenty of light, and the shadows of this place are vicious and dark. Do they belong here? Or did you bring them with you?

People tend to forget. I didn’t. Neither did you, I guess.

Lifesigns is a visual novel about people who moved to the City, seeking change and a better life. Would that be enough to free themselves from their past?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383620/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这里的一切都好陌生。有点可怕，不过……我们会习惯的，对吧？

你原本的生活在身边燃烧、崩塌。你将最喜欢的杯子和一本书塞进包里，踏上寻觅的旅程，寻找一个能够再次找回自己的地方。混凝土与玻璃筑成的高楼直刺天际，城市嗡嗡作响，霓虹灯连深夜都明亮耀眼。光无处不在，到处都是光，可这里的阴影却险恶而深沉。它们原本就属于这里吗？还是你把它们带来的？

人总会忘记。我没有。我猜你也没有。

《Lifesigns》是一部视觉小说，讲述一群迁往“大都市”的人，追求改变与更好的生活的故事。这就足以让他们摆脱过去吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1383620/]Steam[/url]]
